answer: Every claim climbs the cipher of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the copper re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. By the nadir of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, published publicly on failure, rewards vest against future work. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
